glossary.definition: The practice of embodying your Beyonder potion's 'role' to digest it safely. More faithful acting = faster digestion.
The layer of a soul that reveals emotional state. Visible through Spirit Vision.
The capital of the Loen Kingdom. A sprawling industrial city of fog, factories, slums, and aristocratic mansions.
A person who has consumed a potion and gained supernatural abilities along a divine Pathway.
A weapon imbued with spiritual power that can damage spirit bodies, incorporeal beings, and spiritually reinforced targets.
The layer of a soul governing emotion, reason, and self-awareness. Lies between Astral Body and Spirit Body.
A measure of how close a Beyonder is to losing control. Max CoR = Will score. At max, becomes NPC monster.
The process of safely incorporating a potion's power. Tracked as 0% to 100%. Must be near 100% before advancing.
The outermost layer of a soul. Shows physical health - white = healthy, dark = ill.
When a Beyonder's CoR reaches maximum. They transform into a monster or mad creature - permanently removed from play.
One of 22 divine progressions. Each runs from Sequence 9 to Sequence 0 and grants specific abilities.
An alchemical brew that grants Beyonder powers. Must be brewed from specific ingredients. Brings side effects and corruption risk.
The numerical rank of a Beyonder's power level. Sequence 9 = newly awakened. Sequence 0 = god-equivalent. Lower numbers are stronger.
A Beyonder ability that reveals auras, Ether Bodies, Astral Bodies, and supernatural entities. Costs 1 SPI per activation.
A shared psychic realm containing the unconscious minds of all sentient beings. Accessible via Visionary-pathway abilities.
